document_versions.title: Synthetic Mock Clinic Cast Care (Historical)
document_versions.full_text:
Synthetic mock clinic material: Cast Care, version 1.0.

Keep the cast dry and do not insert objects inside it. Contact the fictional clinic if the cast becomes broken, wet, or unusually tight.

This synthetic fixture is not medical advice. For a real concern, follow the instructions from your treating team.

document_versions.full_text:

document_versions.title: Synthetic Mock Clinic Hours and Contact
document_versions.full_text:
Synthetic mock clinic material: Hours and Contact.

Fictional Fracture Clinic hours are Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00 local time. For fixture questions only, use 555-0100 or mockclinic@example.test.

This synthetic fixture is not medical advice and the contact details are not real.
